currentPhase.description: RC715 is imported as the active development baseline. Standalone stabilization continues from GitHub; stable human promotion remains pending.

developmentBaseline.candidate: RC715 durable library and rename candidate

authorizedWork: standalone functional, UX, accessibility, persistence, performance, test, and release stabilization in this repository
heldWork: localStorage to IndexedDB migration unless required for standalone stability
prohibitedWork: modifying RC715 application source during the import pull request
maintaining a separate canonical standalone source after GitHub cutover
microservices before a demonstrated extraction need
synchronization of opaque global snapshots as the sole merge model
canonical identifiers derived from editable titles
direct UI coupling to storage or remote APIs
parallel AI implementation without exact baseline and machine-checkable scopes
publishing an artifact different from the artifact tested
presenting the RC715 development baseline as a human-promoted stable release
presenting target architecture as current implementation

activeRisks.statement: RC715 source import is in progress; repository build reproducibility is not proven until the import workflow reconstructs the expected artifact from the committed source.
Branch protection and mandatory review rules are not yet independently verified through repository policy evidence.
Changed-file scope enforcement for AI work packages is specified but not yet implemented.
RC715 is automation-ready but its final human persistence, rename, desktop, Android, keyboard, and assistive-technology promotion gate remains pending.

nextMandatoryGate.condition: A precise GitHub commit passes the complete human standalone promotion gate and is selected as the stable forensic baseline.
